snippet.title: [Seoul Alleys before U sleep] The passion island/Day and night of Yeoljeongdo (Relaxing Video)
snippet.description:
Yeoljeongdo(열정도) means island of passion in Korean.
An undeveloped area left behind in the middle of a redeveloped area.
It looks like an island in the middle of skyscrapers.
A few years ago, a group of young people started opening stores there.
It started with six stores and now is more than 40 stores. 


————————— BGM information ————————— 
Song: Disclosure - Latch (Ehrling Remix) (Vlog No Copyright Music)
Music provided by Vlog No Copyright Music.
Video Link: https://youtu.be/VUZmwZ6aPVE

snippet.title: [Seoul Alleys Before U Sleep] Seochon village 西村 / Slowly walking in Ogin-Gil (Relaxing Video)
snippet.description:
The area called Seochon(西村), meaning west village,  is nicknamed the village west of Gyeongbokgung Palace(景福宮). Seochon, where many artists used to live, It is a town famous for its friendly old alleys of Korea. In recent years, many modern shops have sprung up. So, it's interesting to see the mix of the old and the present of Seoul. It is a good place to walk from Gyeongbokgung Station on Subway Line 3. ​

snippet.title: [Seoul Alleys Before U Sleep] Itaewon梨泰院 / Slowly walking in Hoenamu-Gil (Relaxing Vid) | Soyo Seoul
snippet.description:
Among the Koreans, the street called Hoenamu-Gil (회나무길)’  is Hoenamu-Ro 13ga-Gil, Itaewon.
The street is famous for restaurants of many Korean star chefs. There are also many design workshops.

It is the upper street of ‘‘Gyeongridan-Gil (경리단길)’,  a popular and crowded street these days. So it would be fun to walk around and compare these two streets.  

If you walk up near around Namsan Gymnasium, there is a quite famous rooftop bar in Seoul.
The night view of the city is always lovely.

snippet.title: [Seoul Alleys Before You Sleep] Sinchon 新村 / Taking for a night walk in Yonseiro (Relaxing Video)
snippet.description:
On weekends, Yonsei-Ro is a vehicle-free street and becomes a kind of square. There are many street performances all over the place. It's a different atmosphere than Hongdae where is very famous for street performances. This street is a great place to walk and watch on weekends.

snippet.title: [Soyo Seoul] Quick cycling around Nami island 南怡岛 ナミナラ
snippet.description:
Nami Island, famous for its filming location in the Korean drama ‘Winter Sonata 冬季恋歌 冬のソナタ’, is not much to see.
However, it is a great place to enjoy cycling in hot summer, with the cool river breeze coming through the trees.

snippet.title: [Seoul Alleys Before U Sleep] Euljiro/A night walk in dried pollack alley (Relaxing Vid)| Soyo Seoul
snippet.description:
* Nogari - Dried young pollack (Koreans favourite side dish for beer) * 

Euljiro Nogari Alley, designated as the future heritage of Seoul, refers to the area in Euljiro 3(sam)-ga, where tools and construction material stores are concentrated.

This place is filled with the sounds of machines during the day. As  sun goes down and stores are closed, people who are tired of hot day heat and daily routines gather one by one, and wash off fatigue of the day with cold draft beer and Nogari.

Euljiro Nogari Alley started in ‘Eulji OB Bear’ which opened in 1980, and  it was the first time Nogari was introduced. 

On June 22nd-23rd, the 2018 Euljiro Nomac(Nogari + Beer) Festival was held. 


———————  BGM information ——————— 
Song: Xad - Story (Vlog No Copyright Music)
Music provided by Vlog No Copyright Music.
Video Link: https://youtu.be/Sm3dsdmjA2I
—————————————————————————
